_comment: Maximum line width, in em, for terms matching each regex (first match wins). Visual-order Arabic must be wrapped at build time: when TMP wraps it, the lines come out in reverse order. Card panel: ~13.8 em wide at its usual size, measured in-game 2026-09-25. Everything else falls back to 20 em: a line wrapped narrower than its box only costs width, one wrapped wider than its box reads bottom-to-top.
